item.title: MDLR JAM 04 - Live 5U Modular Session
item.description: video upload by rimela "In this patch, the Korg Polysix becomes part of the modular ecosystem. Its filter CV input is driven from the modular. Chord progressions are rythmically shaped by trigger and clock signals coming from the Roland TR-505. String layers from the Roland RS-09. Drums are the Corsynth DR 01/02/03. modules. Recorded live in one take."
